[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Find Pivot Index** [LC 724 · Find Pivot Index](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-pivot-index/){difficulty="Easy"}

The pivot test is "left $=$ right", and the right side is only $\text{total}-\text{left}-a[i]$. So one running sum plus the total is enough — and the pivot element must be removed from *both* sides, which is the single place an off-by-one can hide.

[Solved in full in @sec-pref-p1-b.]{.card-link}

:::
